findings.description:
Reentrancy in ZZZLiquidityManager.balance(bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#257-329):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- p = balancingRouter.plan(targetPool,lower,upper,amount0,amount1) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#302)
	Balance read before the call:
	- tokenPrefund = IERC20(target.key.currency1).balanceOf(address(this)) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#268)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- address(this).balance != nativePrefund || IERC20(target.key.currency1).balanceOf(address(this)) != tokenPrefund || _balanceContext(targetPool) != context (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#322-323)
		- stale variable `tokenPrefund`
findings.rationale: balance is fixed-Vault-only and nonReentrant. tokenPrefund is deliberately the pre-existing Manager balance, not the entrant amount. plan's actual-core quote reverts its simulated changes; final equality proves the whole entrant budget was refunded/spent without using prefunds. _balanceContext then performs full normal execution validation. A changed balance rejects atomically rather than authorizing a payout from a stale snapshot.
findings.review_scope: Individually reassessed current context against exact a846 source/call paths; no automatic prior disposition carry. Internal triage, not independent audit, gas acceptance or market/provider qualification.
